description: This file defines a state management store named 'notesStore' for a notes application. It manages application state (notes items, selected note, query, loading status, errors) and provides methods for initialization, refreshing data, creating, saving, deleting notes, and selecting a note, all leveraging the LightningJS Blits plugin system.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the notes store by creating a NotesService instance, loading data, and setting the initial selected note.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reloads notes from the service and updates the store state accordingly.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets a search query and refreshes the notes list based on it.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with default title and empty content, then refreshes the list and sets the new note as selected.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note with new data, refreshes the list, and sets the note as selected.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by id, refreshes the list, and updates the selected note accordingly.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects a note by its ID.
